description: Check whether an appliance model is ENERGY STAR certified, or list certified models (most efficient first), from the EPA's official data. Categories: heat pumps, heat pump water heaters, clothes washers, clothes dryers, refrigerators, dishwashers. Use this when someone asks if a model is ENERGY STAR, which models are most efficient, or about energy-efficient appliance choices. Heat pump answers include the fact that federal 25C/25D tax credits ended after Dec 31, 2025. Do not use for prices (use compare_prices) or recalls.

model.description: Model number or part of it, to check certification

most_efficient_only.description: Only models meeting ENERGY STAR Most Efficient criteria (not available for water heaters)

title: Shopper: find ENERGY STAR models
